description: This file defines the WildcardMatch class within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation internal namespace. It provides static methods for escaping wildcard characters and comparing strings against wildcards, used internally for spreadsheet calculations.

classes.name: WildcardMatch
classes.description: A utility class for handling wildcard pattern escaping and comparison within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation internals.

methods.name: wildcard
methods.description: Converts a wildcard pattern using Excel-like syntax into a regex pattern with proper escaping, handling special characters appropriately.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Checks if a given string matches a specified wildcard pattern using regex matching.
